reason: Preserve stable98IDs while applying newer accepted personal-workspace retirement, Owner-only board metadata edit and explicit project+board grant decisions; no acceptance score or feature closed.

ACC-04.acceptance: First authenticated use ensures one personal workspace and sole owner atomically; concurrent retries cannot create duplicates. Manual workspace creation stays retired with typed 410; project creation uses the ensured owner context.

ACC-06.acceptance: Show only owned projects and explicitly granted projects; current context is reauthorized and being owner elsewhere grants no extra rights.

ACC-07.acceptance: Ownership transfer stays unavailable in the current beta through every route and UI affordance; direct requests return the documented typed retirement response with no ownership/quota mutation. No transfer capability is claimed.

INV-01.acceptance: Owner invites manager/member/viewer; manager invites member/viewer only. Invitation grants only exact project membership, never implicit board access; independent board grants are explained.

RBAC-05.acceptance: Membership and board access are distinct: non-Owners require both; invitations grant no boards automatically. Owner administers board grants; Manager receives creator access to a board they create. UI and APIs disclose current effective access without hidden-board metadata.

BRD-02.acceptance: List only currently accessible project boards; Owner alone edits board name/description with expected version without breaking card IDs/links. Metadata-only machine credentials receive only their explicitly allowed fields.

QRY-03.acceptance: Show actor assignments within one selected authorized project and currently granted boards with due-state filters/pagination; no cross-project aggregation or revoked-access content.
